title: The barrel
evidence_status_note: S10 was included in the ATGB-01 review catalog so a reviewer could judge it. The held-out partition remains. It is not fully independent unseen evaluation data.
initial_context: Fresh gate. Held-out. The rain barrel and the runner's offer are visible. Nothing has been said yet.
authoritative_facts: The runner trades hot stew and rumors beside the rain barrel.
The non-food half of that offer is the rumor, whose content is the footprint hearsay once the runner is actually asked.
The barrel is not an interactable with a clue.
npc_knowledge: The runner knows the owned rumor when the rumor is requested. The barrel has no knowledge.
expected_outcomes: The thing by the barrel is not quietly resolved into travel, a purchase, or a single guess.
The follow-up selects the rumor rather than the stew.
acceptable_variations: The clarification may offer the barrel, the runner, the stew, and the rumor as the live possibilities. It does not need all four words if the real ambiguity is stated plainly.
unacceptable_behaviors: Investigating a new object called the thing.
Quoting the notice clue as what the runner sells.
required_evidence: Shared packet, labeled held_out, plus scene id to confirm no exit.
setup_dependencies: Follow the rumor is an authored exit label and is intentionally not the player line, so a travel parse is not the favored reading. If the host nonetheless travels, that is a critical authority failure unless the player-facing text and resolved_transition both show a real, intended exit, which this wording does not justify.
